name: compile_fractals
description: Compiles indented SASS fractal mixins into CSS. Useful for live preview in OpenDesign, web apps, or verifying style output.

sassCode.description: Indented SASS code. Can use any fractal mixin (+surface, +stack, +gap, etc.).

className.description: Optional CSS class name to wrap the mixins under (e.g. 'preview-card'). Defaults to 'element'.
